jobs.title: Political, Crisis & Litigation, Associate Consultant
jobs.reason: The candidate's exceptional academic background in International Relations and Politics aligns strongly with the role's focus on political and public policy analysis. They meet the minimum 12 months of experience through relevant student assistant roles involving research, data analysis, and policy reporting. While direct commercial consulting experience is a gap, their strong analytical, technical (Python, SPSS), and communication skills make them a highly competitive applicant for this Associate Consultant position.

jobs.title: Senior Research Fellow – Russia & Eurasia
jobs.reason: This role is far too senior for the candidate, requiring a highly experienced researcher with a substantial track record in leading research, policymaker engagement, and fundraising. Crucially, the role also requires fluency in Russian, which the candidate does not possess. While the candidate has strong academic credentials in International Relations and good research skills, the specific regional focus and the seniority level are a significant mismatch.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Music Performance
jobs.reason: This role is for a Lecturer in Music Performance, requiring a PhD in Music and a strong profile as a performer and educator. The candidate's academic background and interests are exclusively in International Relations, Law, and Policy, with no relevant musical or performance experience. The required qualifications and experience level are significantly beyond the candidate's current academic status and student assistant experience.
jobs.location: Bloomsbury, Camden, Greater London, United Kingdom

jobs.title: Embedded Intelligence Analyst
jobs.reason: The candidate has a strong academic background in International Relations and Security Studies, aligning well with the role's focus on intelligence, geopolitical risk, and threat assessment. They possess excellent research, data analysis, and writing skills, along with multilingualism. The main gap is the requirement for 1-3 years of professional experience in an intelligence or customer-focused role, which the candidate, with their MSc in progress and student assistant experience, does not fully meet. However, the job description encourages applications from candidates who meet some requirements and can offer a unique perspective, making it a plausible fit.

jobs.title: Administration Officer
jobs.reason: The candidate's strong academic background in International Relations and Law, with a focus on international law and genocide, aligns well with OSF's mission and the legal support aspects of the Office of the General Counsel. They possess strong language skills and relevant administrative experience from student assistant roles, including organizing meetings and managing documentation. However, the role requires "proven experience as a highly skilled administrator/executive assistant" and specific contract/invoice administration, which the candidate's current experience might not fully meet at a professional level.
jobs.location: London, Nairobi or Rio De Janeiro

jobs.title: LSE Fellow (GV101)
jobs.reason: While the candidate's academic background in International Relations and Political Science, strong research skills, and publications align well with the field, the role explicitly requires a completed or near-completed PhD by September 2026. The candidate will only be starting their MSc in September 2025, making them ineligible for this specific academic fellowship.
jobs.salary: £43,277 to £51,714 pa inclusive with potential to progress to £55,497 pa inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Junior Designer
jobs.reason: This role is for a Junior Designer, requiring a design degree, a strong portfolio, and experience in a creative environment. The candidate's background is entirely academic, focused on international relations, law, and policy research, with no design experience or portfolio. While the candidate has some HTML/CSS knowledge, it's not sufficient for the core design requirements.

jobs.title: Seasonal Face to Face Fundraising Festivals and Events Manager
jobs.reason: This role is an operational management position focused on face-to-face fundraising and event coordination, requiring specific experience in these areas and people management. The candidate's background is highly academic, focused on international relations, law, and policy research, with experience as a student assistant. There is a significant mismatch in both the field of work and the required professional experience and specific skills for this operational fundraising management role.
jobs.location: London, United Kingdom (and on-site at festivals across the UK)

jobs.title: Research Assistant for Defence and Military Analysis Programme
jobs.reason: The candidate is an excellent fit for this Research Assistant role. Their MSc in International Relations Research, coupled with a forthcoming publication specifically on "changing defence/security policies," demonstrates a direct and strong alignment with the programme's focus. They possess all required research, data analysis (SPSS, Python), and policy writing skills, and the "Research Assistant" level is perfectly suited to their academic background and extensive student assistant experience.
